name: Noachian-Nunatak
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed an orbital debris ring in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on salvageable alloys, silicon and uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
